exam_context: SSC CGL Tier 2 2026, Paper I — the MERIT-DECIDING stage of the two-tier selection process for Combined Graduate Level Group B and C posts. Unlike Tier 1, Paper I marks are carried forward into the final selection score.
data_provenance: Estimated from SSC's official CGL Tier 2 exam pattern/notification as reported by multiple 2025-2026 coaching/exam-tracker sources (PhysicsWallah, Adda247, CareerPower, ExamSuchana, Prepgrind, Prepp), cross-checked Sep 2026. Some trackers report Paper III (General Studies: Finance & Economics, for AAO/Assistant Accounts Officer posts) has been dropped from the 2026 cycle while others still list it as active for that post category — flagged as unconfirmed; verify against ssc.gov.in.

marking_scheme.source_note: Confirmed via multiple Sep 2026 sources describing the SSC CGL Tier 2 Paper I marking pattern for the 2026 cycle.
marking_scheme.correct_answer: +3 marks per question (uniform across Mathematical Abilities, Reasoning & General Intelligence, English Language & Comprehension, General Awareness, and Computer Knowledge)
marking_scheme.incorrect_answer: -1 mark (negative marking) — a heavier penalty than Tier 1's -0.5, reflecting Tier 2's merit-deciding status
marking_scheme.merit_deciding_nature: Paper I marks ARE counted in the final merit list (unlike Tier 1, which is only qualifying). Final post allocation depends primarily on Tier 2 Paper I performance.
marking_scheme.computer_knowledge_cutoff_note: Computer Knowledge carries its own separate qualifying cut-off in addition to contributing marks to the total. Failing this module's cut-off can disqualify the entire Paper I attempt regardless of the overall score.
marking_scheme.dest_note: The Data Entry Speed Test (Session 2) is qualifying only — no marks, no negative marking, not part of the 450-mark total.
marking_scheme.question_types_used: Single-correct 5-option MCQ only across all five graded sections. No descriptive, numerical-value, or multiple-correct questions in Paper I.

session_1.note: 2 hours 15 minutes combining Sections I, II and III.

section_I.content: Mathematical Abilities (30Q) + Reasoning and General Intelligence (30Q)

session_2.content: Data Entry Speed Test (DEST) — 2000 key depressions, qualifying only

exam_logistics.sectional_timing_caveat: Trackers disagree on whether Sections I and II are single 60-minute blocks (as described here) or further split into per-subject sub-timers (e.g. 30 min Maths + 30 min Reasoning within Section I). Verify the live interface behaviour against the admit card/official mock test rather than a single source.
exam_logistics.extended_duration_pwd: Extended time typically granted for candidates with benchmark disabilities, per standard SSC accommodation policy
exam_logistics.medium_of_exam: English and Hindi, except the English Language & Comprehension section, which is English-only
exam_logistics.who_takes_this_paper: Paper I is compulsory for every SSC CGL post. Paper II (Statistics) is additionally required only for Junior Statistical Officer / Statistical Investigator Grade-II posts and is out of scope for this file.

tier2_paper3_finance_economics.applicable_to: Assistant Audit Officer / Assistant Accounts Officer posts only (status for 2026 cycle unconfirmed — see data_provenance)
